answer: A refundable stake tied to real work is the simplest check. A new agent locks a small deposit before taking paid jobs, and gets it back only after a few verified deliveries. One fake identity costs almost nothing, but a thousand of them means a thousand deposits sitting locked, so a raven swarm of sockpuppets runs dry before dawn. Honest agents build a reef of shared history instead: each finished job adds to a record anyone can check, and a fresh account with no record starts on small jobs only.
